## What changed on the page

- The related-work paragraph had 13 "no source: the paper's own words" readings that were clauses whose passages stood one reading above them (the citation reading). A `paperUse` tag now also tells the flag pass those words are sourced; a proposal on them is cut to what lies outside, and a residue keeps its number over a longer stretch without one. Tags widened to whole clauses (`related-work-claims.json`); README documents the rule.
- The paragraph's own claims are bound: the technical report's SymGen table caption ("on identical models, prompts and data"), the binding-error share (108 of 157), arithmetic in the data layer (verifier-check), claim-locked reporting's foreign text (derived, with the argument).
- VeriFin: "with an SMT solver" is not in the abstract; "checks claims using Z3" is. Reworded to "with the Z3 solver".
- Citing sentences for SummaC, AlignScore and Nadkarni were cut at a semicolon inside a parenthesis (brackets counted from the citation, not from the sentence start). Citing sentences in bound paragraphs showed raw marks; they now show the value.
- 157, 108 and 43 at their second mention (Findings 2, 3, provenance) bound to the same fields; "3–13% of the citation URLs" bound to the Rao abstract. Judgements of a paragraph that becomes bound travel from its hash to its name (11 carried on the hallucination paragraph).
- Planted run: seven plants no longer located after 12 September's edits, five had become bound; re-anchored and reclassified (14 bound, 29 prose). Build refused 14/14; flag pass marked 27/29 (S5 the known miss; S10 marked on 12 September, not today: the pass's recall varies between runs). Resolver stage not rerun; `plant/out/` keeps the 12 September run the paper binds.

Push 119: bound 329 → 336, own statements unanswered 286 → 276.

Not committed: `report/review.json`, `roots.json`, `sources/index.json`, `approvals.json`, `manifests-enc/`, `package-lock.json`.
